# Passports and Grub

> > Luxury travel blog by Tomiko Harvey inspiring Black women travelers over 40 through cultural immersion, food experiences, and solo travel adventures.

Passports and Grub is a travel and food blog founded by Tomiko Harvey, a luxury travel influencer, SEO strategist, and member of the Black Travel Alliance. The site focuses on slow travel, cultural immersion, and empowering Black women travelers with destination guides, travel safety tips, and authentic culinary experiences around the world.
